text: What exactly did Mr. Arnold do to make you dislike him so much?
Stealing files? Lying about me? That kind of thing?
It wasn't just me, though. It was everybody.
Curtis, I'm calling a sort of impromptu meeting at the Dreaming Tree.
I think we all need to get out of here for a while.
A really tragic thing happened today.
If anybody should want to talk to a grief counselor,
the company will make one available to you.
I don't know what else to say, guys.
Tell Tom I had to go, okay?
